roadmap.title: Render and export a bounded Blender asset

roadmap.title: Validate the licensed Unreal project
roadmap.description: After importing an owner-provided Linux engine, run project inspection and DataValidation on reviewed plugins and content.

roadmap.title: Review graphics delivery evidence
roadmap.description: Verify output format, engine compatibility and current permissions. Claim only adapters that passed real execution.

knowledge.title: Creative VPS execution contract
knowledge.summary: Fixed Blender, Unreal, Inkscape, ffprobe and licensed Photoshop API operations use reviewed project roots, scoped expiring authority and durable receipts. Local cancellation does not prove a remote Adobe job stopped. Interoperability work must use authorized assets and tools.
